test_cases.test_case: Display upcoming activities in the Timeline block
steps: 1. Select 'Next 7 days' from the Time Range dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: The Timeline block displays upcoming activities for the next 7 days

test_cases.test_case: Create a new calendar event
steps: 1. Click the 'New Event' button in the Calendar block
test_cases.expected_result: A personal calendar entry is created

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to the previous month in the Calendar block
steps: 1. Click the 'Previous Month' button in the Calendar block
test_cases.expected_result: The Calendar block displays the previous month

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to the next month in the Calendar block
steps: 1. Click the 'Next Month' button in the Calendar block
test_cases.expected_result: The Calendar block displays the next month

test_cases.test_case: Open the full calendar view
test_cases.expected_result: The dedicated calendar view opens

test_cases.test_case: Open the calendar data management
steps: 1. Click the 'Import or export calendars' link
test_cases.expected_result: The calendar data management opens

test_cases.test_case: Reset the page to default in Edit mode
test_cases.expected_result: The page resets to default

test_cases.test_case: Open the block types listing in Edit mode
test_cases.expected_result: A page listing all available block types opens

test_cases.test_case: Check the visibility of move icons in existing blocks in Edit mode
test_cases.expected_result: Each existing block shows a move icon

test_cases.test_case: Check the visibility of three-dot menus in existing blocks in Edit mode
test_cases.expected_result: Each existing block shows a three-dot menu for configure, move, and delete actions

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to create a new event without filling required fields
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; no calendar entry is created; error shown on required fields

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate to the previous month in read-only mode
test_cases.expected_result: No navigation occurs; current month remains displayed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to reset the page without being in edit mode
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; page remains unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access 'Full calendar' link without authentication
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access 'Import or export calendars' link without authentication
steps: 1. Click on the 'Import or export calendars' link
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to enable Edit mode on the course page
steps: 2. Attempt to click on the Edit mode button
test_cases.expected_result: User is blocked from enabling Edit mode; no changes are made to the course content

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access a non-existent activity or resource link
steps: 2. Click on a link that does not exist
test_cases.expected_result: Page displays an error indicating the resource is not found; no navigation occurs

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to collapse all sections after navigating away from the page
preconditions: User is on the Course Page and has expanded sections
steps: 1. Click on a section to expand it
2. Navigate away from the Course Page
test_cases.expected_result: All sections remain in their last expanded state; 'Collapse all' link is still visible and clickable.

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly click the 'Collapse all' link multiple times
preconditions: User is on the Course Page with sections expanded
steps: 2. Immediately click the 'Collapse all' link again
test_cases.expected_result: 'Collapse all' action is processed once; all sections are collapsed and the link remains functional.

test_cases.test_case: Check behavior when navigating to a section with long section names
preconditions: User is on the Course Page
steps: 1. Navigate to Section 1 with a long name that exceeds typical length
test_cases.expected_result: Section name is fully displayed without truncation or overflow issues.

test_cases.test_case: Check behavior when navigating to a section with special characters in section names
preconditions: User is on the Course Page
steps: 1. Navigate to Section 2 with special characters in the name
test_cases.expected_result: Section name is displayed correctly without errors or encoding issues.

test_cases.test_case: Display student's own grades in the grade table
test_cases.expected_result: The Grades table displays the student's grades with the columns: Grade item, Calculated weight, Grade, Range, Percentage, Feedback, and Contribution to course total.

test_cases.test_case: Collapse and expand grade items in the grade table
steps: 1. Click on a Grade item header to collapse it
2. Click on the same Grade item header to expand it
test_cases.expected_result: The Grade item collapses and expands correctly, showing or hiding the graded activities beneath it.

test_cases.test_case: Verify the aggregation course total is displayed
steps: 1. Observe the bottom of the Grades table
test_cases.expected_result: The 'AGGREGATION Course total' row displays the cumulative grade across all weighted items.

test_cases.test_case: Open submission form
test_cases.expected_result: The submission form opens

test_cases.test_case: Submit with Online Text Editor
steps: 1. Enter text in the Online Text Editor
test_cases.expected_result: Submission created

test_cases.test_case: Submit with File Upload
steps: 1. Upload a valid file in the File Upload area
test_cases.expected_result: Submission created

test_cases.test_case: View submission status
preconditions: At least one submission has been made
steps: 1. Click View on the Submission Status Section
test_cases.expected_result: Displays submission details

test_cases.test_case: Edit submission
preconditions: At least one submission has been made
steps: 1. Click Edit on the Submission Status Section
2. Make changes in the submission form
test_cases.expected_result: Submission edited

test_cases.test_case: Upload a file at the maximum allowed size
preconditions: File size limit is defined in the system
steps: 2. Upload a file that is exactly at the size limit
test_cases.expected_result: File upload succeeds; submission is created with the uploaded file

test_cases.test_case: Upload a file exceeding the maximum allowed size
preconditions: File size limit is defined in the system
steps: 2. Upload a file that is one byte over the size limit
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is blocked; an error is shown indicating the file exceeds the size limit

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long text in the online text editor
steps: 2. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Online Text Editor
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is accepted; the text is saved as entered without truncation

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the online text editor
steps: 2. Enter a string with special characters in the Online Text Editor
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is accepted; the text is saved as entered without errors

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate to an activity when no activities are present
steps: 1. Ensure the Assignments section is displayed
2. Verify that no activities are listed in the Assignments section
3. Attempt to click on a non-existent activity link
test_cases.expected_result: No navigation occurs; the user remains on the Activities page with no error shown

test_cases.test_case: Rapid navigation after clicking an activity name
preconditions: User is on the Activities page
steps: 1. Click on an activity name in the Assignments section
2. Immediately press the back button in the browser
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Activities page without the activity name being pre-filled

test_cases.test_case: Long text in activity name
preconditions: User is on the Activities page
steps: 1. Enter a very long string (200+ characters) in the Name field of an activity
test_cases.expected_result: The input is either accepted or truncated with a visible indicator

test_cases.test_case: Special characters in activity name
preconditions: User is on the Activities page
steps: 1. Enter a string with special characters (e.g., !@#$%^&*) in the Name field of an activity
test_cases.expected_result: The input is accepted or a specific error message is shown

test_cases.test_case: Leading and trailing whitespace in activity name
preconditions: User is on the Activities page
steps: 1. Enter a string with leading and trailing spaces in the Name field of an activity
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; saved value shown in detail page has no extra spaces

test_cases.test_case: Update Profile with all required fields filled
steps: 1. Enter <First Name> in the First Name field
2. Enter <Last Name> in the Last Name field
3. Enter <valid email> in the Email Address field
test_cases.expected_result: saves profile changes

test_cases.test_case: Cancel profile editing
test_cases.expected_result: exits without changes

test_cases.test_case: Open Profile Form from Profile Page
test_cases.expected_result: Profile form is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Send Message from Profile Page
test_cases.expected_result: Message sent successfully

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to update profile with required fields left blank
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; 'First_Name', 'Last_Name', and 'Email_Address' fields are highlighted with inline validation errors indicating they are required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to update profile with all required fields left blank
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; 'First_Name', 'Last_Name', and 'Email_Address' fields are highlighted with inline validation errors indicating they are required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to cancel profile editing without making changes
test_cases.expected_result: Exits without changes; profile remains unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to open profile form without being authenticated
steps: 1. Attempt to access the 'Edit Profile' link without logging in
test_cases.expected_result: Redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to send a message without being authenticated
steps: 1. Attempt to click on the 'Message' button without logging in
test_cases.expected_result: Redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Fill all required fields with minimum valid data
preconditions: User is on the Profile Form
steps: 1. Enter minimum valid data in the First_Name field
2. Enter minimum valid data in the Last_Name field
3. Enter a valid email address in the Email_Address field
test_cases.expected_result: Profile changes are saved successfully; confirmation message displayed.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to submit profile with missing required fields
preconditions: User is on the Profile Form
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission is blocked; inline errors displayed for First_Name, Last_Name, and Email_Address fields.

test_cases.test_case: Enter a long string in the Description field
preconditions: User is on the Profile Form
steps: 1. Enter a string longer than 200 characters in the Description field
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission is blocked; error message indicates the Description exceeds maximum length.

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the First_Name field
preconditions: User is on the Profile Form
steps: 1. Enter special characters in the First_Name field
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission is blocked; inline error indicates invalid characters in First_Name.

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly click Send Message after sending a message
preconditions: User is on the Profile Page
steps: 1. Click Message_Button to send a message
test_cases.expected_result: Second click is ignored; user sees a message indicating the previous message is still being processed.
